name: Iliwayo Jabameogge
source: You joined one of the top game companies in the world. Your happiness is short-lived after you become acquainted with a mysterious but handsome guy and strange things start to happen around you. Will you be able to keep this sweet but scary job?
translation: 你入职了世界顶尖的游戏公司之一。然而，在结识一位神秘的英俊男子后，奇怪的事情开始接连在身边发生，喜悦也随之转瞬即逝。这份甜蜜又令人害怕的工作，你还能继续做下去吗？
